name: Guin Saga ~Hyoutou no Kamen~
original_name: グインサーガ ～豹頭の仮面～
source:
Based on first volume of Guin Saga novels. You are the survivor of the royal family and are chased by mongolian raids.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自《豹头王传说》第一卷。你是王室的幸存者，正遭蒙戈尔侵略军追杀。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
